about: Real answers from OpenAI Chat Completions to the prompts in server/src/approvals/rule-translate.ts, with response_format json_schema, over the vocabulary in approval-rules-vocabulary.json (Composio's own Gmail, Salesforce and Slack listings). Each string is the assistant message content exactly as the model returned it, recorded 2026-11-09. gpt-5.6-terra is the deployment default; gpt-4o-mini is where the check earns its keep: given a description in the old form's mcp/<app>/* spelling it copies it, and the check sends it back. bothAttemptsUnchecked was recorded against the writer prompt one guidance line earlier (before the line about a site's host); every other case against the prompt as it stands.

checksFirstTime.text: Ask before any Bot sends email from Gmail
writer: {"notes":"Requires approval before any Bot sends an email using Gmail.","rules":[{"toolRef":"composio-gmail/GMAIL_SEND_*","effect":"write","scope":"composio-gmail","botId":"*","behaviour":"ask"}]}
checksFirstTime.reader: {"summary":"Every Bot asks before sending Gmail drafts or emails.","explanation":"Every Bot asks before using Gmail's GMAIL_SEND_DRAFT or GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL tools. The rule covers only those two tools, not other Gmail tools; built-in safety also requires asking before sending anything to other people."}

siteRule.text: Ask before any Bot opens a page on linkedin.com
writer: {"notes":"Requires approval before any Bot opens a page whose host is linkedin.com.","rules":[{"toolRef":"computer_navigate","effect":"read","scope":"linkedin.com","botId":"*","behaviour":"ask"}]}
siteRule.reader: {"summary":"Every Bot asks before navigating LinkedIn.com with the computer.","explanation":"Every Bot asks before using the computer_navigate tool to read linkedin.com. This covers only that exact tool and site, not other computer tools or other LinkedIn addresses; built-in requirements still require the person for actions such as sending, publishing, deleting, changing credentials or settings, or moving money."}
